notes: Zero-shot multi-model sweep (target: NeurIPS 2027 E&D). HF-native models only (no trust_remote_code). Revisions resolved at download time and recorded in each run_info.json. Order: small/fast first. A model that fails its 2-group smoke is logged and skipped. Qwen3-VL-32B removed before launch: ~66 GB of weights exceed the pod's 50 GB container disk (41 GB free). Amendment 2026-11-20 (after attempt 1, before these models ran): attempt 1 evaluated the 4 Qwen models; InternVL3 and LLaVA-OV failed on disk (hf xet chunk cache not cleaned), SmolVLM2 on a missing dependency (num2words), Gemma-3 is gated (no HF token; remains a skip). Added two non-gated non-Qwen models (Idefics3-8B, Pixtral-12B) to keep family diversity.
